title: Odd-seed Rosser bouquet-with-center: carrier-join criterion + De-Morgan collapse

A_Lstar_seeded_bouquet.carrier: L* = {bot<c1,c2,p ; c1,c2<w ; w<U ; p<U}, w=c1 v c2 in carrier
A_Lstar_seeded_bouquet.witness_map: bot->U, c1->w, c2->U, w->w, p->p, U->bot  (Fix={w,p}, detached seed p)

A_demorgan_subclass.note: lattice antitone dual-endomorphisms = abstract shadow of D2-normality
A_demorgan_subclass.conclusion: normal(De-Morgan) + boxt(w)=w  =>  twins FUSED; separated bouquet requires ~D2

B_hexagon_center_contrast.x_join_y_in_carrier: absent (lub=U); c1 v c2 is a MacNeille cut only
B_hexagon_center_contrast.conclusion: join absent in carrier => Henkin center is completion-manufactured & seedless (Thm 123a); any carrier seed is a DISTINCT detached point

C_alpha_and_phantom_tax.conclusion: phantom tax = exactly 1 atom for EVERY H, independent of independence-complex connectedness

theorems.Thm124a: Carrier-join criterion: Henkin center is carrier-seeded <=> bouquet disjunction exists in the carrier. ConLat_T Boolean => rho_1 v rho_2 exists => seeded regime.
theorems.Thm124b: De-Morgan collapse: on L*, normal(De-Morgan) boxt with boxt(w)=w forces FUSED twins (4 fix w, 0 separated); the separated seeded bouquet-with-center exists only in the ~D2 (non-normal) regime. Carrier shadow of Thm 123b.
theorems.Thm124c: Modal profile: twin-plus-center realizable in Guaspari-Solovay R with D1 ^ ~D2; base box remains GL (D3 not forced to fail); uniqueness fails because GL needs normality, already gone.
theorems.Cor124d: Phantom tax = 1 for every H; connectedness of the independence complex affects |MaxInd| (absolute alpha) but not the tax.
